items.prompt: We’ve seen that a whole number can be written as a fraction over one. We can use that to write a mixed number as a sum of fractions. My turn first: here’s a mixed number 2 3/5. It means two whole units, add three fifths. 2 + 3/5 And then the two can be written as fraction over one.
Now, watch what I change. 2 4/5 We can write that as a sum of fractions, like this
Watch what I change again. 6 4/5 We can write that as a sum of fractions, like this.
items.demo: *6/1 + 4/5* Each time, the whole number goes on top of a one, and the fraction stays as it is.
